title: Circuit rewiring with two constant inputs
statement: Given a circuit with $N$ input vertices, a natural number $k$, and a list of $N$ source vertices, suppose the list has length $N$ and every listed vertex is less than $k+2$. Rewiring produces a circuit on $k$ inputs by placing constant-false and constant-true gates first, then appending the original gates with their inputs redirected according to the source list; its output is the vertex $k+2$ plus the number of original gates.
hypotheses_covered: each source vertex is less than k+2
